text:
Kiran: Post all-hands quick sync on win/loss signals. Trying to get leadership alignment on what to push into Q1. Short summary: wins = predictable TCO + automatic fallback to smaller quantized models; losses = onboarding friction (SDK & VPC demos), opaque 5xxs during key rotation, and missing per-route token audit for compliance folks.

Lena: Can we list concrete examples that triggered losses? Sales flagged three deals: one pulled after failing to get a VPC demo in time, one couldn't debug 500s during a load POC, and one stalled because SDK samples were out of date.

Kiran: Exactly. Also multiple customers explicitly asked for a CSV export of per-route token usage and for a pricing example page for mixed retrieval+generation flows.

Marta: Ops note: the 500s look tied to large eval jobs on dedicated pools. ops-bot: run latency-and-error-report --from 2025-10-01 --to 2025-11-30 --job 8275

ops-bot: Job 8275 queued (requested by @Marta). Results: https://internal/redwood/jobs/8275. Summary: spikes correlated with bursty eval traffic; a few key-rotation endpoints returned 500 with empty bodies.

Ben: Leadership asks: prioritize (A) correlation_id + better 5xx UX, (B) SDK quick doc refresh + single-page integration checklist, (C) CSV export prototype for per-route billing, (D) pricing calculator + scenario writeups, (E) POC concierge offering. Which do we do first?

HeadOfSales: We need (A) and (B) yesterday. (C) would be a strong trust signal for enterprise procurement. (E) is important, but high-touch 1% of deals need it.

Kiran: Product/engineering note: correlation_id + 5xx UX low effort, high impact. SDK docs small effort too. Console CSV export needs design but prototype in 3-4 weeks seems doable.

Lena: Also, for (A) let's make sure our load balancers don't swallow response bodies and that the error format is consistent across edge -> runtime -> model. We lost one deal when the error chain yielded no actionable info.

Marta: Agree. We'll add admission control on Dedicated to cap eval bursts. Also adding a heartbeat for key-rotation endpoints to detect silent failures earlier.

Ben: Can we get owners and rough ETA here so sales can follow up?

HeadOfSales: Owners: (A) Eng Runtime (Marta) ETA 3 weeks; (B) DevEx (Kiran) ETA 1.5 weeks; (C) Console (Lena) prototype ETA 4 weeks; (D) Product ETA 6 weeks; (E) CS+Solutions draft ETA 4 weeks. I'll share these with sales ops.

Kiran: I'll make an action tracker with owners/ETAs and share link here. Also please add any anonymized customer quotes to the doc.

Lena: Noted. Also one positive signal: customers appreciate auto-fallback to quantized variants and that has been a differentiator in 4 wins this quarter. Let's include that in collateral.

HeadOfSales: Good call. Sales will highlight the auto-fallback and predictable pricing in the next set of outreach templates.

Kiran: Thanks team. ops-bot: attach job 8275 link to the tracker. ops-bot: job attached. :thumbsup:
